news.title: Using student housing to sharpen your retention strategy
news.summary_en: Ask any university president how they can improve visibility into student well-being and satisfaction, and housing may not come up at all, yet housing teams have insight into some of the earliest and most robust signals of student risk and satisfaction anywhere on or off campus.

news.title: Access: The overlooked foundation of institutional data effectiveness
news.summary_en: Many program evaluation reports articulate the need for better data analysis. The key to that analysis is often access. Higher-education institutions have invested heavily in data collection, analytics platforms, data warehouses, and business intelligence tools.
